gloss: to take up (a pen); to conduct; to direct

definitions.gloss: to take up (a pen, a task); to conduct; to direct
definitions.explanation: To take charge of a task or the tool of a role, in fixed formal phrases: to take up the pen, take command, conduct business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧⟦{指揮|しき}→指揮：11102_shiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{執|と}った。
examples.english: The company president took command personally.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十年間|さんじゅうねんかん}、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{教鞭|きょうべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{執|と}ってきた。
examples.english: He has taught at this university for thirty years.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{執|と}る

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{執|と}る: to take up the pen, to write
- ⟦{指揮|しき}→指揮：11102_shiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{執|と}る: to take command; to conduct (an orchestra)
- {教鞭|きょうべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{執|と}る: to teach (as a profession)
- ⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{執|と}る: to conduct business, handle office work
- ⟦{執|と}り{行|おこな}う→執り行う：19902_toriokonau⟧: to perform (a ceremony)

WRITING:
One of several kanji for とる. ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ is the everyday verb; {執|と}る appears only in these formal set phrases. Writing ⟦{指揮|しき}→指揮：11102_shiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ is also seen, but {執|と}る is standard.
